label: Bible Study
prompt: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy _____ shall be established for ever.
verse: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
note: God's covenant with David — a house, a kingdom, and a throne established for ever.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall _____ you up.
verse: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
note: Bow low before the Lord, James says, and He'll do the lifting.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become _____ throughout all the land of Egypt.
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
note: Modern versions often say gnats; the KJV says lice — the plague where Pharaoh's magicians finally admitted, 'This is the finger of God.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: I do not _____ the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
verse: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
note: 'Frustrate' means set aside — if law-keeping could make us righteous, Paul says, the cross was in vain.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath _____ upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verse: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
note: 'Behold, what manner of love' — John pauses mid-letter to marvel that we're called the sons of God.
